CHAPTER 02 · OPEN WHEN YOU NEED A SMILE

a letter for you

No birthday. No special occasion. Just something I want you to know.

💌

Dear Wael,

I don't think you know how grateful I am to have you in my life.

It's kind of amazing that two people in different countries can find a connection that feels this meaningful. You're in Syria, I'm in India, and even though we haven't met in person, I'm genuinely thankful that our paths crossed.

I know life hasn't always been gentle with you. You don't have to pretend your past didn't hurt, and you don't have to be strong every single moment. I hope that, with time, life gives you more reasons to feel safe, more moments of peace, and people who treat you with the care you deserve.

The kindness you show me means more than I can explain. I treasure our conversations, the little things you share with me, and the fact that we can be ourselves with each other. I wish you could see yourself through my eyes for a moment—not as someone defined by painful experiences, but as someone who can still be caring, thoughtful, and deeply important to another person.

We may be far away and we may not have met yet, but I'm glad you're here. I hope this little website can make you smile on a difficult day and remind you that you matter outside of everything you've been through.

You deserve gentleness, Wael. You deserve peaceful days. And I hope the future brings you so many good things that the hard days don't get to tell your whole story.

I'm so grateful for you. ♡

CHAPTER 06 · OUR LITTLE TIMELINE

still going, still growing

Tap a moment to open it.

First conversations

where it all began
Two people in two different countries, typing hello. I had no idea that a few messages would turn into someone I'm this grateful for.

Late-night talks

the quiet hours
When the world goes silent and the honest conversations start. These are the talks I think about the most, the serious ones, the random ones, and the ones where neither of us wanted to say goodnight.

The jokes begin

officially dangerous
Somewhere along the way you made me laugh for real, and it became my favourite thing to look forward to. Your sense of humour is a gift. Please never retire it.

Getting to know each other

the little things
Learning what makes you smile, what you care about, and how kind you are when you think nobody's keeping score.

Today

still here
This little garden exists because you matter to me. Still here, still grateful, still glad it's you on the other side of the screen.
